newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ming Pao faces HK$200 mln provision - papers.
newsitem.headline: Ming Pao faces HK$200 mln provision - papers.

text.p: Ming Pao Enterprise Corp Ltd is seen facing a HK$200 million provision for the current fiscal year in view of a questionable loan to a Chinese state-owned enterprise made by former controlling shareholder CIM Co Ltd, newspapers reported on Tuesday.

Newspapers quoting Ming Pao's managing director Hui Hau-tung as saying that the board would consider taking legal action if CIM or the state-owned company failed to repay the loan by the end of September.
Ming Pao officials were not immediately available for comment. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
